commands: ros2 launch course_bringup patrol.launch.py namespace:=robot_a subscriber_reliability:=reliable record:=false bag_dir:=/home/iakup/robotics_ws/evidence/pr05/record-disabled-must-not-exist
ros2 launch course_bringup patrol.launch.py namespace:=robot_a subscriber_reliability:=best_effort record:=true bag_dir:=/home/iakup/robotics_ws/evidence/pr05/bag

tests.name: Build all three packages and load installed launch arguments
record=false creates no recorder or bag; record=true creates MCAP
Live best-effort publisher: reliable receives none, best_effort receives poses
Replay both QoS profiles from the same single-topic MCAP bag
All launch children stop cleanly on SIGINT
Official PR05 evidence contract (course kit v1-w06)

defect.reproducer: Launch with subscriber_reliability:=reliable and record:=false. The /robot_a/sensor_pose topic is visible, but reliable echo times out with RELIABILITY incompatibility. Repeat reliable echo during replay of the corrected bag: it also times out.
defect.root_cause: pose_relay offers BEST_EFFORT reliability, while the subscriber requests RELIABLE. The offered reliability cannot satisfy the requested profile even though topic name and message type match.
defect.proof_after: Use subscriber_reliability:=best_effort: live delivery works. Record one MCAP stream with 429 poses, stop all live nodes, then replay this exact bag with config/qos-overrides.yaml. The best-effort listener receives poses, while the reliable listener still receives none. Diagnostics and ros2 bag info are saved in qos-before.txt and qos-after.txt.
